title: supply-chain-lib ImageImport spec
description: An image this pipeline did NOT build, put through the supply chain (acquire -> [harden] -> scan -> gate -> publish -> sign). Same envelope as the base-image factory specs.

spec.description: An image the factory did NOT build, put through the same supply chain (acquire -> [harden] -> scan -> gate -> publish -> sign). Complete on its own: the author supplies source, destination, origin and every mandatory governance label; base.name / base.digest / created are derived by the pipeline.

origin.description: vendor: third-party image, never hardened, `labels.vendor` names the third party. internal: built by one of our pipelines, hardening optional, `labels.vendor` defaults to ours.

ref.description: image ref; upstream hosts are rewritten through the pull-through map, internal refs pass through

digest.description: sha256:... to pin; empty = resolve the live digest on every run (tracking mode)

version.description: tag base (<path>:<version> floating, <path>:<version>-<digest12> immutable); default = the source tag

harden.description: internal only: wrap-build harden.sh + flatten (re-emits the image config). Rejected for origin: vendor.

labels.description: governance labels. vendor and description are mandatory; source and revision default to the Jenkins checkout and any value here overrides them; authors, documentation, licenses, version are optional. Nothing is defaulted by the library.

runtime.description: with harden: true, which runtime trust store gets the internal CA besides the OS store. auto detects keytool/cacerts (java) or python3 (python).
